name: Railway
line: Hosted database services for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis and MongoDB.

free.text: Trial $5/30d; new deploys suspended; Free $1/mo; volumes delete 30d after expiry

cells.regions: US, Europe and Singapore; volumes follow services

sql.math: Assumes 0.5 GB of RAM, 0.05 vCPU, a 1.2 GB volume and 5 GB of egress. Per-second rates give $6.525664. Per-minute rates differ.
An always-on idle example assumes 0.5 GB of RAM, 0.05 vCPU and a 1.2 GB volume. The per-second total is $6.275664.

files.math: 100 GB a month of storage costs $1.50. Direct S3 operations and transfer are free. The Hobby workspace has a $5 minimum.

jobs.math: Active job compute is $0.0579. The $5 applies only if workers stop between jobs. Minimum worker, queue and transfer costs are incomplete.
